description: Na₂Sr₇Al₆F₃₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-67°. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and four longer (2.43 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-67°. There are two shorter (2.23 Å) and four longer (2.29 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.93 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.94 Å. In the third Sr site, Sr is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to ten F atoms. There are six shorter (2.58 Å) and four longer (2.87 Å) Sr-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlF₆ octahedra and corners with two NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-55°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.86 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.85 Å. There are ten inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sr and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Sr and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNaSr₂Al tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Sr and one Al atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Sr and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Sr atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Sr₂ tetrahedra. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Al atoms.
